author: L. Leslie Brooke
title: Johnny Crow’s Garden
edition: First edition, 1903, identified in the source. Only the original verse is supplied; picture captions, advertisements, and illustrations are omitted. Transcription treatment: HTML inline emphasis is represented as plain text; page numbers, image captions, illustrations, and digitizer boilerplate are excluded. Prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed within each paragraph; verse line breaks and stanza boundaries are retained, with indentation whitespace normalized. Original wording, spelling, and punctuation are retained, including apparent historical or transcription oddities.

rights.basis: The selected English literary text was published in 1903, before 1931, and its maximum 95-year US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this ebook as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg10469-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page, and the publisher's advertisement pages after the verse. The book's text is the single verse picture-book: its title heading and each picture's verse (set in the HTML as h2 cells beside the pictures) as one stanza; the closing "GOOD-BYE!" is kept as a stanza.
